# age_reading_error

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

This repository contains code and data for fitting the stock assessment model SAM with age-reading error for scale reading of NSS herring. SAM is implemented in the R package [stockassessment](https://github.com/fishfollower/SAM).  A prototype version (currently found in a [branch](https://github.com/fishfollower/SAM/tree/ageconfusion)) of the software can adjust for age-reading errors. The data and the model configuration have been downloaded from the "NSSherring_1_cwb dataset" at https://www.stockassessment.org.
